Under Article 3 of the plan, emergency services are covered regardless of network status, and the patient presented with symptoms meeting the prudent layperson standard for an emergency medical condition. The insurer’s reliance on Article 4 is misplaced because that provision only applies to non-emergency out-of-network services, which this was not.", "arguments": [{"point": "The services rendered constituted an emergency medical condition under the plan’s definition and thus are covered under Article 3, irrespective of network status.", "support": [{"source": "policy", "ref": "P2", "quote": "Emergency services are covered in-network and out-of-network without prior authorization. Emergency services provided by an out-of-network facility will be covered at the in-network cost-sharing level.
